title: banger arena
tagline: Banger Arena: bet on viral tweets and train an AI shitposting agent from CT trends.
description: Banger Arena is a CT-native prediction game where every viral tweet becomes a betting arena. Users stake YES/NO on whether a post will cross its “banger” threshold, earn on-chain rewards if they’re right, and help train an AI shitposting agent from real-time Twitter trends. Anti-bot filters, creator revenue sharing, and a degen-friendly UI make it feel like fantasy sports for virality.
how_its_made: leveraged cdp embedded wallet to enab le seamsless login and one click transactions from user perspective, further customized with twitter api to fetch and then smart contract on base sepolia for users to stake or place their predictions ont eh virality of the tweet - the goal is to let users invest and possibly earn by predicting virality of certain tweets passing threshold metrics
